interactions.flavorLineOne:
"Guardian!" Shaxx's voice booms through the Tower. "As we ready ourselves for war, we also ready ourselves for the Guardian Games. Do you know why?"

He leans in closer. "Every game contains a lesson. Eva's is simple but necessary. It doesn't matter if the stakes are a trophy or all our lives: victory comes to those who best understand themselves."

"If you're a Titan, be the wall that others break on. Hunters, find your triumph in guile! Warlocks… turn your wisdom into weaponry."

"You are the champions of the City. Fight and win. Now and forever." Shaxx crosses his arms and nods to you. "Now enter the Crucible and show me you understand."

"I see you've found your edge," Shaxx says with a nod.

"That's a good start, but the hard part is keeping it. Diligence and discipline, Guardian. I look forward to seeing your future matches."
Lord Shaxx has a gift for you: a Ghost Shell that will track your victories.
"Wonderful! You look stronger already. I look forward to the heights you will climb!" —Lord Shaxx
As boisterous as ever, Shaxx speaks warmly (and loudly) of Crimson Days—and of his challenge to Guardians who choose to celebrate with him in the Crucible.
It seems unlikely that Shaxx will remove his helmet to consume the cookies, but that doesn't mean he isn't grateful.
"Wonderful! You look stronger already. I look forward to the heights you will climb!" —Lord Shaxx

"Tell me this, Guardian," Lord Shaxx bellows, his horned helmet towering over you. "Did the Cosmodrome sufficiently hone you? Are you prepared to face all the Darkness can muster?"

"You're a fool if you think so. All blades dull with time; keeping yours sharp is a matter of diligence and discipline. For that end, I created the Crucible."

He gestures at an array of screens streaming video footage of Guardians battling each other.

"Pit yourself against your fellow Lightbearers, and we'll see if you have your edge yet."

Shaxx invites you to participate in Crucible matches against other Guardians and to complete the Crucible bounties he offers.

Shaxx brightens as you approach, visibly standing taller as your presence registers.

"There you are, Guardian! I'd hoped to see you today. I've designed a new Crucible experience—for improvement, for friendly competition, and the glory of being hailed throughout the City for your skills!

"That last part will come with time. Everyone starts from the same place, after all. Once you've fought a few matches, I'll pair you with opponents who will sharpen you to a razor's edge.

"Well? Want to give the competition a try?"

Lord Shaxx shifts from foot to foot like a giddy schoolchild. His remaining horn waggles in the breeze.

"Guardian!" he greets you, barely containing his enthusiasm. "I have some thrilling news."

"I'm hereby opening THREE NEW CRUCIBLE ARENAS!" His bellowing attracts several nearby Lightbearers.

"The first is a defunct research facility, reclaimed from the Fallen. It's built right into an ice shelf on Europa!"

More Guardians begin to hover around interestedly.

"The second is on Neptune. I've convinced the Neomuni to donate a mall as a Crucible site!"

The group of intrigued Lightbearers is growing. Shaxx begins gesturing broadly, playing to the audience.

"And finally," he announces. "I have secured the most prestigious battleground of them all… A CAPTURED PYRAMID!"

"And not just any Pyramid," Shaxx continues. "The fell lair of the famous, the notorious, Final God of Pain himself… NEZAREC!"

There's a clamor as the eager crowd closes in.

"See you on the battlefield!" Shaxx shouts to you over the din.
Compete in the Crucible. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

interactions.flavorLineOne:
You can now shape and reshape weapons using the Relic on Mars.

Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons across the system. Extract the Pattern mod or dismantle these Deepsight Resonant weapons to acquire progress toward additional weapon Patterns.

With this new information, return to Ikora in the Enclave on Mars.

Gather Resonant materials like Resonant Alloys, Ascendant Alloys, and Patterns to create and customize your favorite weapons.

Level up the weapons to unlock better components by using the Shaped weapon in combat and activities.

There is no limit to the number of times a weapon can be reshaped. Experimentation with different components is highly encouraged.

Continue to find Resonant weapons and extract the Resonant mod or dismantle the weapon to make progress on Weapon Patterns.

Patterns and various materials are required to customize your weapons during shaping.

As you shape and level weapons, you'll unlock new traits to experiment with. 

Ascendant Alloys will help unlock Enhanced Traits, making your Shaped weapons far more lethal than their normally acquired versions.

Deepsight Resonance extraction can award Patterns.

Patterns unlock the ability to shape a new weapon using various currencies for customization and fine-tuning.

Your Ascendant Alloys have unlocked new capabilities for Shaped weapons. Is this a memory of what was, or what could be?

After Shaped weapons are leveled, Ascendant Alloys can be used to upgrade your traits to become Enhanced Traits with improved functionality. 

To obtain more Ascendant Alloys, participate in weekly campaign missions and The Witch Queen offensive activities.

Deepsight Resonant weapon Pattern extraction can award Pattern progress.

Patterns unlock the ability to shape a new weapon using Resonant materials for customization and fine-tuning.

A Shaped weapon can be continually enhanced by reshaping it with new components and perks.

The higher the level, the higher the quality of components available.

Take the Enigma to the Relic on Mars and reshape it.
The vision of a foundry weapon dances across your mind, its shape half-remembered. It will take effort to fully understand it.
A vision of a foundry weapon dances across your mind, its shape half-remembered. It will take effort to fully understand it and give it shape.
A clawing at the back of your mind: your Deepsight stirs. The memory of a weapon appears in your mind, but you can't yet make it clear.

The shadow of power manifests in your thoughts. An intense wave of certitude grips you. To discover the true power of these weapons, their shapes must ascend.

Ascendant Alloys are a rare material used in weapon crafting that can improve a trait into an Enhanced Trait.

Obtain one by completing a weekly campaign mission.
You have shaped your first weapon: the Enigma. However, further increasing a Shaped weapon's level can unlock additional capabilities.

Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons and activated latent features of others. These weapons can be obtained through world drops and activities and contain Deepsight Resonance. Extraction of the Pattern mod or dismantling of the weapon will make progress toward Weapon Patterns. 

Weapon Patterns are primarily obtained through Deepsight Resonance, and occasionally as a reward from specific quests.
Your mind focuses on a vision of the City's foundries. Their weapons have not yet reached their innate potential.
